title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 23: the census of the Levites, their divisions and their duties in Yahweh's house.

questions.text: When David was old and full of days, whom did he make king over Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:1 says that David, old and full of days, made Solomon his son king over Israel.

questions.text: What was the number of the Levites counted from thirty years old and upward?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:3 says that their number, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

questions.text: According to David, how many of the Levites were to be officers and judges?
questions.explanation: David said that six thousand of them were officers and judges.

questions.text: With what did the four thousand Levites praise Yahweh?
questions.explanation: David said they praised Yahweh with the instruments which he had made for giving praise.

answers.text: Instruments sent by the king of Tyre
Instruments that Moses made long ago in the wilderness
The instruments David had made for giving praise

questions.text: By which sons of Levi did David divide the Levites into divisions?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:6 says David divided them according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

questions.text: Who was separated to sanctify the most holy things and to burn incense before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:13 says Aaron was separated, he and his sons, to sanctify the most holy things and to burn incense before Yahweh.

questions.text: What were the names of the sons of Moses?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:15 names the sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

questions.text: Eleazar the son of Mahli died with daughters only. Who took his daughters as wives?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:22 says their brothers, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

answers.text: The sons of Mushi the Levite
The priests, the sons of Aaron
Their brothers the sons of Kish
Men from the tribe of Judah

questions.text: What did David say the Levites would no longer need to carry?
questions.explanation: David said the Levites would no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.

answers.text: The stones for building the king's house
The tabernacle and all its vessels

questions.text: When were the Levites to stand to thank and praise Yahweh?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:30 says they were to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening.

answers.text: Once a year at the set feast
Only at noon on each day
